name: Please Be Quiet Bergen 2026

venue.name: [Paviljongen, nedre Ulsetskogen kulturhus](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ymeQ4arczoTP3Mih6)
venue.details: Use the main entrance and go left to the competition area.

information:
**Norsk:**
Vi kommer til å bruke et annet lokale enn de siste tre årene.
Denne konkurransen tar utgangspunkt i blindegrener. Konkurransen vil **IKKE** holde 3x3.

**English:**
We will use a different venue than the past three years.
This competition mainly holds blindfolded events. The competition will **NOT** hold 3x3.
